_comment: Base runs the OP Stack, so src_chain/dst_chain stay "opstack" in config.json —
the relayer accepts only cosmos|ethereum|opstack|arbitrum (cmd/main.go). Base and
Optimism are told apart by module NAME and client id, not by chain type. That is
rollup_profile is sent verbatim into MsgCreateClient and the Rust verifier rejects
unknown fields (#316), so it carries exactly the five keys the client reads. The
settlement fields (dispute_game_factory, game_list_slot) and the ethereum_client
reference are gone: the client verifies nothing against L1.
profile_version must match the artifact — op_attestor_v1 / base_attestor_v1 /
arbitrum_attestor_v1 — or instantiate fails with InvalidProfileVersion.
l2_chain_id must be the chain l2_rpc_url actually serves. Both
`create-clients-cosmos --l2-config` and `start` verify it against eth_chainId and
refuse to proceed on a mismatch; the create path also refuses when the endpoint
does not answer, because it is about to commit the profile into a client that
cannot be corrected afterwards. Nothing else reads the field - transactions take
their chain id from the RPC - so before these checks a wrong value relayed
happily against whatever chain the URL served.
